scope: Existing-outline guarded laboratory PSU prototype only, 207–253VAC50Hz, ambient0–40C; manual assembly

independent_U1_short_protection.action: Dual comparator/reference and latched SCR crowbar, upstream F1 opens; independent of U1 control
independent_U1_short_protection.limitations: Does not promise LED survival or protect every failure of the protection circuit itself

qualification_conditions: C6peak<=90V and total fault-to-effective-crowbar response<=150us for the specified cold/hot U1-short cases; calculated timing is conditional, not measured.
Actual total F1 interruption<=26ms in the modeled downstream fault. Manufacturer6ms@10In is prearcing, not a total clearing guarantee.
RF1 may sacrifice itself; confirm safe opening without sustained arc, flame or ejection at hot253VAC, and BR1initialjunction<=90C engineering screen.
C7effective>=70nF at actual AUX5V and0–110C; C10+U2input+layout<=130pF.
At actual AUX4.86–5.09V verify U2VOHdrop<=250mV at4mA, comparator contribution<=2us and POR<=200us after2.4V crossing.
Verify BAT54C forward<=0.8V and inactive-branch leakage<=100uA over declared conditions; gate-only remoteQ1cathode difference<=50mV.
Normal OCP_FILTER peak<=0.65V including wirewound shunt inductance and layout pickup. Normal specific20S LED peak target<=280mA; no nuisance latch at startup/restart/line corners.
R24singlefault energy allocation<0.89J is a one-shot hot engineering screen, not repetitive-pulse qualification. Inspect actual AC01 lead form before powered tests.

C6case target<=75C, stop characterization at85C; T1body planningtarget<=90C; R6body stop100C. Q1pre-fault case<=70C engineering screen and absolute junction110C. No sealed-enclosure temperature approval.
Require measured longer AC01 lead>=25.5mm before forming, finished front height<=17.5mm, coating gap>=0.5mm and solder tail>=0.5mm. Module22.0nominal/22.16max-PCB planning envelope.
Normal operation requires the compatible LED load. An open output may deliberately latch the crowbar and sacrifice F1; it is not an automatically resetting no-load mode.

Rapid/warm restart readiness must be characterized. Under the declared0.45mA prereg load envelope, passive AUX remains awake for C6>=6.7146V; independently modeled reachable reset warmstart retains158.96us readiness margin. This is a conditional screen, not an arbitrary AUX-reset/C6-charged guarantee.
Characterize charged-C6 ordinary output short, clamp/latch retention and negative shunt transient recovery. Input-current limiting does not prove functional comparison while the input is clamped.
No powered LED replacement; deenergize and verify discharge. All LED nets are mains referenced and not SELV.
Copper loss screen assumes30–35um tracecopper and conditional20um finished-hole plating. Actual fabrication and all thermal/waveform limits need verification.
